scope: Keep the Editor draft recoverable after a stale-version Save conflict on a narrow viewport.

behavior.reproduction: At 390px, the viewport-fixed mobile toolbar intercepted both revision-conflict recovery buttons because the conflict section stretched into the workspace grid row.
behavior.fix: The conflict state adds a narrow-screen grid template with a natural-height recovery row; the state class is removed after explicit latest-version reload or successful Save.
behavior.save_publish: A rejected stale Save leaves the public snapshot unchanged. The local JSON export preserves the edited document. Replacing it with the latest server draft still requires the existing explicit confirmation.
